hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored svdEntropy reproduces antropy.svd_entropy (order 3, delay 1) BIT-FOR-BIT, and the value is a valid entropy in bits (0 < H < log2(order)).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: svdEntropy equals antropy.svd_entropy to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9)
